classification_guide.structural: Semantic or layout HTML elements that define paragraphs, headings, lists, tables, and quoted blocks.
classification_guide.inline_formatting: Inline tags used for emphasis, styling, or legacy font markup inside paragraphs.
classification_guide.link: Anchor tags linking to external websites, documents, or other AKU pages.
classification_guide.media: Embedded images, videos, or other rich media referenced inside the article.
classification_guide.embedded: Non-visible or script/style markup embedded in HTML. Review carefully before removal.
classification_guide.inferred: No explicit note exists yet for this tag. Classification was inferred from the HTML tag name.
